title: Polynomial-time closure of padded verification
statement: Let $C,c\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $V$ be a language of binary strings in polynomial time. The padded verifier for $C,c,V$ is also in polynomial time.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a language of binary strings
replaced:
Let $C, c \in \mathbb{N}$ and let $V \subseteq \{0,1\}^{*}$ be a language in
$\mathsf{P}$. Consider the language $V^{\mathrm{pad}}_{C,c}$ of binary strings $y$
such that, for the least $n$ with $n + (C+1)(n+1)^c = |y|$ (which must exist),
the suffix $v$ of $y$ after its first $n$ bits contains a $1$, and the prefix $u$
of $v$ preceding its last $1$ satisfies $|u| \le C(n+1)^c$ and
$\langle x, u\rangle \in V$, where $x$ is the first $n$ bits of $y$ and
$\langle x, u\rangle$ is the self-delimiting pair encoding ($x$ with every bit
doubled, then $01$, then $u$). Then $V^{\mathrm{pad}}_{C,c} \in \mathsf{P}$.
